description: Incendios_Forestales_MIRA is a dataset listed in Uruguayan spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (IDEuy), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales de Uruguay (IDEuy). Focos de incendios del tipo forestal registrados en el sistema MIRA. Las fuentes de información son los CECOED; SGSP; Prensa La ubicación del los puntos es una estimación muchas veces verificada en campo y otras mediante imágenes satelitales. También cruzando información de reportes vs servicio de la NASA - FIRMS. Coverage: Uruguay. Its tags are archivo shapefile focos de incendio, Uruguay, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-ideuy-portal.
